title: Point of Incidence
description: Find reflection lines in patterns, then fix a smudge to find a new one.
writeup:
## Approach

For each pattern, check all possible horizontal and vertical reflection lines. A valid reflection means the rows (or columns) on each side mirror each other.

## Part 1

Find the line where all mirrored row/column pairs match exactly. Horizontal reflections contribute `100 * row_index`, vertical ones contribute `col_index`.

## Part 2

Instead of an exact mirror, find the line where exactly one character differs across all mirrored pairs — that single difference is the "smudge" to fix. This elegantly avoids brute-forcing every possible smudge position.
